headline: Broad-Based Growth; ADS Momentum Strengthen Outlook

highlights: Growth was broad-based across all three segments, led by ADS (+206.5% YoY) and international business (+56.2% YoY).
EBITDA grew 47.6% YoY to Rs2.1bn, with margin expanding by 201bps YoY to 19.4% (35bps/46bps above NBIE/consensus) despite wage and freight cost pressures.

Adjusted PAT rose 52.2% YoY to Rs1.09bn, beating NBIE and consensus estimates by 13.6% and 1.8%, respectively.  Outlook: Management gave FY27 revenue guidance FY27 of Rs42.5- 43.0bn (+21.5-22.9% YoY), implying H2 revenue of Rs21.4-21.9bn, modestly above H1.
Visibility has improved: the ADS backlog rose to Rs58.7bn (vs Rs44.6bn in Mar-26), aided by a large semiconductor order, while the non-ADS order book rose to Rs22.4bn (vs Rs18.5bn in Jun-26).
valuation: FY27 capex has been raised to ~Rs8bn (from ~Rs5bn), while margins are expected to remain steady.  Valuation: SEL continues to diversify beyond ICE, with ICE’s share of revenue declining to ~66% in 2QFY27 and targeted to fall to ~60% over the medium term.

CMP: Rs4,320 | Target Price (TP): Rs4,607 | Upside: 7% November 8, 2026 Institutional Equities Sansera Engineering (SANSERA) 2  Order Book Momentum Extends Multi-Year Visibility: Sansera’s non-ADS order book (peak annual revenue) rose to Rs22.4bn as of Sep-26 (vs Rs18.5bn in Jun-26), led by PV/CV (Rs9.6bn) and 2W (Rs5.9bn).

ADS is targeted to contribute 35-40% of revenue towards the end of the decade, with a refreshed formal vision expected at FY27-end.  Aerospace Business: Sansera added a couple of aerospace customers and secured its first business from Safran, covering engine components other than rotating parts.

Higher-margin ADS, tech-agnostic, and non-auto businesses are driving mix improvement and margin expansion, with ADS remaining the key growth engine.
